title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
hook_text: Meta's new AI on your desktop
script:
Meta just launched its most capable open-weight AI model called Muse Spark.
It is the first model in its class that runs directly on your desktop.
You need two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios to power it.
This setup relies on Apple's latest MLX framework to manage the load.
Meta claims this model outperforms every other US open-weight model available today.
This makes high-end local AI computing possible without needing cloud servers.
Would you buy two Mac Studios just to run this AI locally?
